description:
Two private functions added as infrastructure stubs in opi-0gw.9 emit compiler warnings because nothing calls them yet:

```
warning: function handle_component_event/2 is unused
warning: function apply_component_result/3 is unused
```

Both functions live in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`. They are intentional stubs for the component-event aggregation layer; they will be wired in when components start emitting events. Until then the warnings are noise.

**Fix:** Wire `apply_component_result/3` into `handle_model_selector_key/2` to process the `new_ms` (pass-through) case, and use `handle_component_event/2` inside it — replacing the two bespoke branches with a single dispatch. The `:cancel` and `{:select_model, model}` branches keep their explicit logic since they need side-effects (CoderSession.set_model) and state merges that go beyond what the generic event handler provides.
title: Suppress unused-function compiler warnings for apply_component_result/3 and handle_component_event/2
